decisions.reason: The existing message-146 MODIFY already updates the FAQ to state that the founder receives $4 per sale minus applicable fiat fees; no additional or corrected Event is needed.
Deducting fiat fees from the founder allocation does not change whether fiat buyers need wallets or which wallet-dependent activities require one.
The revenue-allocation change does not alter the Transak provider, payment methods, conversion behavior, or buyer access requirements.
The source preserves the $5 commission and does not change its allocation to a random existing NFT holder when no referral code is entered.
The founder's treatment of fiat fees does not change the NFT asset type, unlimited supply model, $15 mint price, or mint-number identifier.
The source does not change the Small Block prize amount, draw trigger, qualifying sales, or ongoing pool-funding rule.
The founder-allocation adjustment does not affect Chainlink VRF selection, ticket weighting, on-chain execution, or Basescan verification.
The source continues to specify an immediate automatic $5 referral commission and changes only the founder's allocation for fiat mints.
The allocation of fiat fees does not affect which NFT-associated book access, referral code, badges, or prize tickets transfer on secondary sale.
The founder-allocation change does not alter any NFT metadata counter, badge, or referral-code attribute.
The source does not change the random-holder allocation of prize tickets when no referral code is used.
The treatment of fiat fees within revenue allocation does not change SIWE or the crypto flows requiring wallet authentication.
